knowledge:
- key_parameters: Object=A matrix of coordinates in a reduced dimension space used in imbalance_score ;; conditions=A vector of condition assignments for each cell ;; k=The number of neighbors to consider for raw imbalance score calculation ;; smooth=Dictates the smoothness of the local smoothed scores in imbalance_score ;; sds=A SlingshotDataSet object representing the inferred trajectory ;; rep=Number of permutations used to generate trajectories under the null in topologyTest ;; methods=Test methods to use in topologyTest (e.g., "KS_mean", "Classifier", "wasserstein_permutation") ;; global=Logical indicating whether to test pooling all lineages/pairs in progressionTest or fateSelectionTest ;; lineages=Logical indicating whether to test every lineage independently in progressionTest ;; pairwise=Logical indicating whether to test every pair of lineages independently in fateSelectionTest
- alternatives: slingshot=Used for trajectory inference to generate the SlingshotDataSet object ;; tradeSeq=Used downstream for gene-level differential expression analysis along trajectories (using fitGAM and conditionTest)
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing single-cell RNA-seq (or other single-cell 'omics) datasets with multiple conditions to investigate how conditions affect cell differentiation trajectories (topology, progression, and fate selection).
- pitfalls: The topologyTest can be slow on large datasets; users can adjust the rep parameter or use parallelization (parallel = TRUE with BPPARAM) ;; Multiple comparisons are made across lineages, so p-values should be corrected for multiple testing ;; Trajectory inference is at the end of a long pipeline, so p-values should be treated as suggestions for follow-up rather than absolute statistical truths

workflows.name: differential_topology_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform differential topology, progression, and fate selection analysis on single-cell data across multiple conditions.
input: reduced_dim_matrix (matrix of coordinates in reduced dimension space)
condition_labels (vector of condition assignments for each cell)
cluster_labels (vector of cluster assignments for each cell)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute imbalance scores using imbalance_score ;; 2. Infer a common trajectory using slingshot ;; 3. Test trajectory topology using topologyTest ;; 4. Test for differential progression along lineages using progressionTest ;; 5. Test for differential fate selection between lineages using fateSelectionTest
workflows.code:
scores <- imbalance_score(Object = df %>% select(Dim1, Dim2) %>% as.matrix(), conditions = df$conditions)
sds <- slingshot(rd, df$cl)
top_res <- topologyTest(sds = sds, conditions = df$conditions)
prog_res <- progressionTest(sds, conditions = df$conditions, global = TRUE, lineages = TRUE)
dif_res <- fateSelectionTest(sds, conditions = df$conditions, global = FALSE, pairwise = TRUE)
